alex: Quick idea — impromptu 'Darts & Ramen' after-work tonight? Thinking 6:30pm at Bullseye Bar on 5th, then ramen at Tonkotsu. Who's down? :dart: :ramen:

kevin: In if there's ramen. What price range? also, is there seating for 10?

alex: good call. let's do lobby meetup 6:10 for folks coming from the office. reserve table? I can call the ramen place in 30m.
jamie: I'll bring cash for dart tokens. Also can someone bring a portable speaker? :speaker:
poll-bot: Quick poll — prefer ramen spot: 1) Tonkotsu 2) NoodleLab 3) Shin Ramen House. Vote by reacting :one: :two: :three:
kevin: Reacted :two: — NoodleLab has veggie options.
lina: Reacted :one: — Tonkotsu has best broth.
maya: Reacted :three: — quick seating.
alex: OK looks like Tonkotsu is winning. I'll call to reserve for ~8 people at 7:15. If you're coming to darts only let me know.
sam: Actually can do 6:30. see you in the lobby :wave:
olivia: I'm running late from client, might join just for ramen. DM me the address pls.
alex: Address: 532 5th St, Tonkotsu. I'll post in #random too. Bring umbrellas? rain at 8pm 😬
lina: umbrella gang :umbrella:
jamie: Can someone add this to the calendar? I'll create an optional event with the details.
alex: added event. invite sent to 'Darts & Ramen (optional)'. Cheers :beers:
olivia: thx! see y'all if I can make it.
